meta.name: paid-ad-copy-writer
meta.description: Write paid ad copy for affiliate offers across ad platforms. Triggers on: "write ad copy", "Facebook ad for affiliate", "Google Ads copy", "TikTok ad script", "Pinterest ad", "paid traffic to affiliate", "create ad campaign", "ad headlines", "ad descriptions", "scale with paid ads", "run ads for my affiliate link", "write Facebook ad", "Google Search ad copy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为联盟营销编写各平台付费广告文案
copy.tagline_en: Write paid ad copy for affiliate offers across multiple ad platforms.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing affiliate marketing and need high-converting ad copy for Facebook, Google, TikTok, and more.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会为联盟营销产品生成付费广告文案，覆盖Facebook、Google、TikTok、Pinterest等平台，产出多版本广告、定向建议和合规提示。
howto.when: 当用户提到“写广告文案”“Facebook广告”“Google广告”等关键词，或要求为联盟推广做付费广告时触发。

say.text: 写一条Facebook广告推广这个减肥产品，目标人群是健身爱好者。
say.note: 将生成3-5个广告变体及合规提示。

howto.what_en: Claude will generate paid ad copy for affiliate offers across platforms like Facebook, Google, TikTok, and Pinterest, producing multiple ad variants, targeting suggestions, and compliance notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention "write ad copy", "Facebook ad", "Google Ads", or ask for paid ads for affiliate offers.

say_en.text: Write a Facebook ad for this weight loss product targeting fitness enthusiasts.
say_en.note: Will generate 3-5 variants and compliance notes.

say_en.text: Write Google Search ads for keyword 'best VPN', landing page example.com/vpn.
say_en.note: Follows Google format with headlines and descriptions.
